labels.text: Write the content here instead of printing it.
Print an artifact's content, or write it to a file.

S32.31.needs: a signed-in account that has an html artifact
S32.31.note: The CLI has no 'design' workspace; export is the artifacts show --out command on html artifacts (file extension comes from apps/cli/src/cloud/artifacts.rs file_extension). The plan's 'Where to find it: not written yet' is stale, since the code exists.
steps: Type `agi artifacts list` and copy the id of an artifact whose type is html.
Type `agi artifacts show <id> --out ~/Desktop/exported-design.html` with that id.
Read the printed path, then open that file in a web browser.

Compare with Expected: the design should be saved as a standalone .html file that displays on its own. Note that the plan says 'design' but the command works on any artifact; an html artifact is the one that becomes .html.
S32.31.where: agi artifacts list, then agi artifacts show <id> --out <path>
